steps.title: Evidence Hash Verification & Chain of Custody
steps.description: Compute and verify SHA-256 cryptographic hashes for disk and memory forensic artifacts to establish tamper-evident Chain of Custody.
tasks: Compute SHA-256 hash and export to `/home/student/dfir-evidence/evidence_hash.txt` using `sha256sum /home/student/dfir-evidence/evidence_mem.raw`

verification.command: test -f /home/student/dfir-evidence/evidence_hash.txt && grep -q 'evidence_mem.raw' /home/student/dfir-evidence/evidence_hash.txt && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Process Tree & Hidden Execution Analysis
steps.description: Write a forensic triage script that reconstructs process hierarchy (Parent PID -> Child PID) to identify unlinked or masquerading processes.
tasks: Inspect active processes and extract PPID relationships (`ps -eo pid,ppid,comm,args`)
Make executable and run the script

verification.command: test -x /home/student/dfir-evidence/process_triage.sh && /home/student/dfir-evidence/process_triage.sh && test -f /home/student/dfir-evidence/pstree_report.txt && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Network Socket IOC & C2 Communication Scan
steps.description: Scan active listening sockets and outgoing TCP/UDP sessions to identify unauthorized remote Command & Control (C2) IP connections.
tasks: Extract foreign IP connections and open ports, saving output to `/home/student/dfir-evidence/netscan_findings.txt`

verification.command: test -x /home/student/dfir-evidence/net_ioc_scan.sh && /home/student/dfir-evidence/net_ioc_scan.sh && test -f /home/student/dfir-evidence/netscan_findings.txt && echo PASS || echo FAIL
